versions.changelog:
Initial release providing workflows and API references for Zhihu AIOps.

- Supports asset queries, monitoring asset creation, dashboard/alarm summaries, CMDB discovery, VictoriaMetrics/Categraf SNMP metrics, and inspection reports.
- Reference-guided usage with detailed workflow steps and API endpoints.
- Requires environment variable configuration for secure, flexible API access.
- No executable CLI helpers included yet—future versions will add production-ready scripts.
